name: Loxapine
aliases: Adasuve®, CL-62362, CL-71563, Cloxazepine, Loxapac®, Loxapina, Loxapinum, Loxitane®
summary: Loxapine, sold under the brand names Loxitane and Adasuve (inhalation only) among others, is a tricyclic antipsychotic medication used primarily in the treatment of schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. It is a member of the dibenzoxazepine class and structurally very similar to Clotiapine and clozapine.
